Algorithm (VERIFIED against EVS 585 references by research — pin it with the three-branch vectors, arithmetic shown in spec comments): stage 1 = digits 1-10 dot-product weights [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,1] mod 11; remainder <10 → that is the check digit; ==10 → stage 2 weights [3,4,5,6,7,8,9,1,2,3] mod 11; <10 → check digit; ==10 → check digit is 0. NEVER-ECHO: the refusal message and any console output contain no typed value (this field needs it more than any other — pin like #283's).
